anti_rules: Do not copy screenshot numbers or imply real source data from the reference.
Do not invent product images, growth, confidence, branch coverage or health scores.
Do not add a workspace/industry switcher or global catalog search without supporting behavior.
Do not reproduce every page as the same arrangement of cards.

protected_elements: Customer product identities and screenshot data are not assets to transplant.
must_transform: Use original generated hero artwork and existing SANKET mark.
Retain actual application routes, controls and industry semantics.
